name: Spotify
subtitle: The sound of data
description: Explore streaming hits, artist collaborations and the audio features behind popular music.
about: A selected 2023 snapshot, not streams earned only during 2023. Duration and a 0–100 popularity score are unavailable. Repeated observations and unknown values are preserved.

tests.name: Spotify snapshot
tests.description: The current 953-row dataset. Checks result columns, NULLs, duplicate counts, values and ordering.

name: Danny’s Diner
subtitle: Small menu. Big questions.
description: Turn restaurant orders into customer insights. Practice joins, membership rules and loyalty rewards.
about: Adapted from Danny Ma’s 8 Week SQL Challenge. 15 sales, 3 menu items and 2 members. Repeated sales represent separate items. Same-day purchases have no internal ordering. Reference solutions here were written for this app, not copied from the paid official solutions.

tests.name: Original diner sample
tests.description: The original 15 purchases, including repeats and nonmember C.

tests.name: Ties & reward boundaries
tests.description: An isolated fixture with tied favorites, duplicate sales, join-day purchases, day 6/day 7 boundaries, January 31 and February 1. Run the same SQL unchanged.
